content.title: Who is Pam Bondi’s partner? The man Trump is reportedly not fond of
content.text: Pam Bondi may be out as attorney general, but one person who has remained consistently by her side is her longtime partner. As Bondi’s departure from the Justice Department dominates headlines, public curiosity has quickly shifted toward the private man who has quietly stood beside her for years. Her partner, John Wakefield, has largely stayed away from the political spotlight, even as Bondi’s career kept her in the national conversation.Pam Bondi’s departure as attorney general has placed her personal life under the spotlight, with many asking the same question about who the man is who has been standing beside her throughout the years. ALSO READ: Trump to fire Cabinet members ‘Left, Right and Center’? DC on edge - who are on the list? Who is Pam Bondi’s partner?Pam Bondi’s partner, John Wakefield, is a U.S.-based private equity executive and one of the founding principals of Varner Wakefield Equity Partners, a firm focused primarily on real estate investments across the United States.Before launching the company in 2015, he built a career in finance and corporate strategy. His professional background includes work as a banker and later as vice president of corporate business development and strategy at Lykes Bros. Inc, as per a report by The Mirror.Academically, Wakefield holds a bachelor’s degree in English from the College of Charleston, which he earned in 1994. He later completed a degree in international business from the Thunderbird School of Global Management in 1998.Despite his business credentials, he has remained largely out of public view, with only occasional appearances alongside Bondi, as per a report by The Mirror.ALSO READ: Oracle Layoffs: Thousands being fired via email without warning—here's what lead to the global restructuringHow long have Pam Bondi and her partner been together?Pam Bondi first publicly hinted at their relationship in 2017. That year, she shared a social media photo from a concert outing with friends, marking one of the earliest public glimpses of the pair together.Since then, Wakefield has appeared only occasionally in public with her, whether at political events, holiday gatherings, or personal trips.Over the years, Bondi has shared rare snapshots of the two together, including White House holiday events and a trip to Ireland in 2022, as per a report by The Mirror.According to reports, Wakefield is also a father of three children, though details about his family life have remained private.ALSO READ: Quote of the Day by Mother Teresa: 'I alone cannot change the world, but…' —Inspiring quotes by saint known for her lifelong devotion to serving the 'poorest of the poor'Why did Donald Trump mention Pam Bondi’s partner?John Wakefield’s most visible public appearance came during Bondi’s 2025 swearing-in ceremony as attorney general. He stood beside her and held the Bible as she took the oath of office.It was during that ceremony that President Donald Trump made the now widely quoted remark about him. Trump said, “I just want to introduce her very, very handsome husband. I hate being around him. He looks too good. He’s been a tremendous factor with Pam and just a beautiful relationship.”Despite that comment, neither Bondi nor Wakefield has ever publicly confirmed that they are officially married. That ambiguity has only added to the intrigue surrounding their relationship, as per a report by The Mirror.What happens next?Now that Pam Bondi has officially been removed as attorney general, attention is likely to remain fixed on both her political future and the people closest to her. Reuters and other outlets confirmed on April 2 that Bondi was dismissed and replaced on an acting basis by Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche, as per a report by The Mirror.For John Wakefield, however, the pattern seems unlikely to change. His public role has remained limited, with his professional life in private equity continuing to define his profile far more than politics. Still, as Pam Bondi’s next chapter unfolds, interest in the man at her side is unlikely to fade anytime soon.ALSO READ: ‘You’re doing a terrible job’: Trump blasts Karoline Leavitt as bad press hits 97%FAQsWho is Pam Bondi’s partner?John Wakefield is a private equity executive and Bondi’s longtime partner since 2017.Are Pam Bondi and John Wakefield married?They have not publicly confirmed that they are married.
